FPS counts frames each second. Higher usually feels smoother. Frame time is how long each frame takes; lower is better. The 1% low helps you spot uneven performance even when the average FPS looks good.

Know what holds your game back.
SVS Performance Monitor shows whether your processor or graphics card is limiting Farming Simulator 25. It watches from outside the game, so nothing is added to the game.
Set up frame times to see how smoothly the game runs. Windows will ask for permission once, then sign out and back in.
You can also do this later in Settings.
SVS Performance Monitor stays in the notification area while it runs.
Open the dashboard with a double-click. Right-click for this menu.
The actual Windows menu uses native keyboard and dismissal behavior.
Waiting uses a neutral outline. Watching uses a green outline with a check. Read the verdict in the tooltip; tiny limit badges would be hard to tell apart.
